sn56.39:1.1: Ye hi keci bhikkhave samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā Idaṃ dukkhan ti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānanti || pe-la ||
sn56.39:1.2: Ayam dukkanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yathā bhūtaṃ nappajānanti || te aññassa samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā mukham ullokenti
sn56.39:1.3: Ayaṃ nūna bhavaṃ jānaṃ jānāti passam passati || || 3.
sn56.39:2.1: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave tūlapicu vā kappāsapicu vā lahuko vātupādāno same bhūmibhāge nikkhitto
sn56.39:2.2: tam enam puratthimo vāto pacchimena saṃhareyya || pacchimo vāto puratthimena saṃhareyya || uttaro vāto dakkhiṇena saṃhareyya || dakkhiṇo vāto uttarena saṃhareyya || ||
sn56.39:2.5: Evam eva kho bhikkhave ye keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā Idam dukkhan ti yathā bhūtaṃ nappajānanti || lape ||
sn56.39:2.6: Ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānanti te aññassa samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā mukham ullokenti
sn56.39:2.7: Ayaṃ nūna bhavam jānaṃ jānāti passam passatī ti || ||
sn56.39:3.1: Ye ca kho keci bhikkhave samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā Idam dukkhan ti yathābhūtam pajānanti || la-pe ||
sn56.39:3.2: Ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yathābhūtam pajānanti || te nāññassa samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā mukham ullokenti
sn56.39:3.3: Ayaṃ nūna bhavaṃ jānaṃ jānāti passam passatī ti || || 6.
sn56.39:4.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave ayokhīlo vā indakhīlo vā gambhīranemo sunikhāto acalo asampakampi ||
sn56.39:4.2: puratthimāya ce pi disāya āgaccheyya bhusā vātavuṭṭhi neva naṃ saṃkampeyya na sampakampeyya na sampacāleyya || pacchimāya ce pi disāya || la-pe || uttarāya ce pi disāya dakkhiṇāya ce pi disāya āgaccheyya bhusā vātavuṭṭhi neva naṃ saṃkampeyya na sampakampeyya na sampacāleyya || ||
sn56.39:4.5: Evam eva kho bhikkhave ye ca kho keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā Idaṃ dukkhan ti yathābhūtam pajānanti || lape ||
sn56.39:4.6: Ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yathābhūtam pajānanti || te nāññassa samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā mukham ullokenti ||
sn56.39:4.7: Ayaṃ nūna bhavaṃ jānaṃ jānāti passam passatī ti || ||
sn56.39:4.11: Dukkhassa ariyasaccassa || la-pe || dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipādāya ariyasaccassa || || 9.
sn56.39:5.1: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave Idam dukkhan ti yogo karaṇīyo || la-pe || Ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yogo karaṇīyo
